blurb:
If you’re looking to get out on the water while here in Miami, look no further than our fantastic 50’ Sea Ray express cruiser, one of the best values in Miami Beach! She’s always clean and comfortable and has everything you need to have great boat day exploring the amazing waterways and scenery found here.

We don't need to have a set tour, we are here to take you where you want to go. If you aren't sure though you don't need to worry - we know EVERYTHING and we're happy to recommend things and make the perfect trip!

So pick a day, get your crew, step on board… IT’S THAT SIMPLE. Fun and relaxation are already here waiting for you!
